articleTitle: Pedestrian Target Tracking Based On DeepSORT With YOLOv5
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Pedestrian target tracking is an important problem in the field of computer vision. To address low tracking accuracy and tracking errors in pedestrian target tracking. This paper developed a YOLOv5-based DeepSORT pedestrian target tracking algorithm (YOLOv5-DeepSORT), which introduces the high-performing YOLOv5 algorithm into the DeepSORT algorithm, which detects the tracking video frame by frame, and then predicts the target position using Kalman filtering while matching the same target using the Hungarian algorithm. To verify the performance of the YOLOv5-DeepSORT algorithm, this paper compares it with the YOLOv3-DeepSORT algorithm for experiments. The results show that the YOLOv5-DeepSORT algorithm can detect and track pedestrians well. Compared with the YOLOv3-DeepSORT algorithm, the MOTA of the YOLOv5- DeepSORT algorithm is improved by 9.9%, the number of false detections and missed detections is significantly reduced, and the number of target ID switching is decreased by 23 times, which proves the effectiveness of the method in this paper.

articleTitle: Automatic Power Transmission Towers Detection Based on the Deep Learning Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Electric power construction is related to the national economy and people’s livelihood. However, some natural disasters, such as typhoons and earthquakes, make the power poles and transmission towers of the distribution network prone to damage. In this context, we use advanced deep learning algorithm to realize automatic detection of power transmission towers. Specifically, we show fast and accurate detection of power transmission towers from video frames taken by unmanned aerial vehicles (UAVs). First of all, we film the power transmission towers using UAVs, and make the datasets through the manual annotation method of video frame taking. Then, an efficient intersection over union (EIoU) is introduced to calculate the loss of predicted box and an activation function Mish is used to replace original activation function ReLU base on YOLO-V4 algorithm. Finally, the center line of the power transmission tower can be obtained by using ResNet-50 to locate its endpoints. Combined with the center line and detected box, the tilt angle of the tower can be calculated. Via testing and comparison, our algorithm can give consideration to both speed and accuracy, which is shown to be more suitable to be applied in power grid disaster survey as compared to other approaches. We believe that this method will play a positive role in the future detection of damages in power transmission towers.

articleTitle: FPGA Placement Optimization with Deep Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The Simulated annealing algorithm has been widely used in FPGA placement. In this paper, we use deep reinforcement learning to enhance the simulation annealing algorithm. We use the Deep Q-Networks based on graph convolution to implement deep reinforcement learning algorithm instead of random method to select the moving block when placer swaps blocks. Experiments show that our method can get a better placement faster than the original VTR in early stage of the placement process.

articleTitle: Research on UAV Target Recognition Technology Based on Federated Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the difficulty of data sharing in the current UAV target recognition model training, and designs a UAV target recognition architecture based on federated learning. And combined with the advantages of YOLOv3 to improve the YOLOv3-Tiny model. Finally, the model is trained in two different scenarios through simulation experiments. The results show that the performance of the model is improved on the basis of protecting data privacy. It provides an index reference for the next step in the in-service assessment of UAV equipment target recognition capabilities.

articleTitle: Research on Raw Material Ordering and Transportation Process Based on TOPSIS and Neural Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The main purpose of this paper is to establish a reasonable model for the selection of suppliers for the purchase of raw materials and the reasonable selection of transporters for an enterprise whose main business is building decorative panels. Reasonable planning and selection of importers are carried out under many factors, such as meeting economic conditions, giving priority to production capacity, meeting inventory and weekly consumption and so on.This question first carries on the relevant cold melon according to the supply characteristics of 402 suppliers. Using the analytic hierarchy process, set a certain weight to the three quantified supply features to calculate the total score of a supplier, and sort it. Then the minimum number of suppliers is obtained by modeling, and these suppliers can meet the minimum requirements of the enterprise. And adopt 0-1 programming model and greedy algorithm to traverse each possibility, and then combined with BP neural network to predict the demand in the next 24 weeks, list the possibility of all selected suppliers to meet this number. After that, the maximum supply capacity and supply law of the supplier are analyzed to improve the production capacity. Enterprises need to increase the proportion of orders from these suppliers and correspondingly reduce the proportion of orders from unreliable suppliers in order to optimize production capacity.

articleTitle: Impaction of Artificial Intelligence on Interaction Design
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In recent years, artificial intelligence (AI) technology has made rapid development. Speech recognition, face recognition, natural language processing, limb recognition and other technologies are becoming more and more mature. The development of human technology has constantly changed the interaction mode between people and computers. For example, the maturity of touch screen technology has brought the popularity of tablet computers. The theme of this study is to investigate the impact of artificial intelligence (AI) technology on interaction design and how to use the interaction mode of AI technology to improve user experience. The research method of this paper is through the investigation of literature and face recognition experiments. The research results show that AI technology has a great impact on interaction design. Chat robot and speech recognition have been applied in many interaction designs. The recognition of facial expressions and human body movements can recognize more detailed feature information (such as expression, mental state, skin state, etc.), open more interaction space and provide users with better user experience.

articleTitle: Research on Intelligent Operation and Maintenance System of Battery Based on Digital Twin
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: With the acceleration of the construction of smart grids, the explosive growth of information brought about by weather, equipment, and electricity/gas/heat multi-energy scenarios in the power system has made it difficult for traditional power simulation systems to meet people’s needs for smart power grid construction. And the combination of machine learning, deep learning, cloud computing and digital twin technology in the Internet of Things has become the key to the current grid construction. This article first analyzes the application of digital twin technology in battery management, creates an intelligent battery operation and maintenance management and advanced measurement system based on the Internet of Things, and provides a certain reference for improving the detection level of battery operation and maintenance management systems.

articleTitle: The influence of image enhancement algorithm on face recognition system
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Aiming at the low efficiency of face recognition devices such as access control systems due to resolution and uneven illumination in dark environments, the Harr feature is used to detect the face, and the EigenFace method is used to extract the characteristic face information, and a face recognition system is established for simulation the actual situation. Using image enhancement methods such as histogram equalization, Retinex, and Median filtering to process portraits, experiments were conducted on the ORL library and self-collected face training set. The experimental results show that some image enhancement algorithms can significantly improve the face recognition rate, and Image enhancement algorithms are conducive to machine recognition in the field of portraits.

articleTitle: Performance Comparative Analysis of Artificial Intelligence Chip Technology
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The rapid development of artificial intelligence (AI) demands the enhancement of domain-specific hardware specifically designed for AI applications. Although the depth of hardware acceleration methods has been dug deeply to tickle this problem, a comprehensive review is not enough to get a detailed knowledge of these cutting-edge techniques. This paper proposes the direction and challenges of different chip designs in the present. In general, the AI chip refers to a chip that has been specially designed for and used in the field of AI algorithms. The frameworks and characteristics of the hardware accelerators based on conventional von Neumann architecture are described as the basic methods. In addition, the amount of data has shown explosive growth, where the traditional computing architecture cannot support the massive transition requirement of the data between computing processor and memory. Inference efficiency becomes the major design consideration for modern machine learning accelerators. The throughput and energy consumption were mainly determined by the efficiency of performing multiply-and-accumulate (MAC) during inference, and new insight to address this problem was provided by a process-in-memory (PIM) method. Finally, inspired by the physiological principle, a pathway of brain-inspired computing becomes an energy-efficient approach to AI computing workloads. The development of various brain-inspired chips based on non-volatile memory is reviewed in this paper, focusing on computing density, energy efficiency, computing accuracy, on-chip learning capability, and co-design principles, from the device to the algorithm level.

articleTitle: Energy saving simulation analysis of natural cooling of fresh air in small and medium-sized data centers in cold winter and hot summer regions
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper introduces the technical principle of direct natural cooling of fresh air and the composition of fresh air system. Taking Shanghai as an example, the control strategy of outdoor fresh air in cold winter and hot summer area is determined. The energy consumption model of data center refrigeration system was established, and the energy consumption of a small data center in Shanghai before and after direct natural cooling with fresh air was simulated. The simulation results show that the energy consumption of the refrigeration system of the data center decreases by 26.3% and 16.8% after using the fresh air direct natural cooling. The application of the fresh air natural cooling technology in the cold winter and hot summer areas has obvious energy saving effect.

articleTitle: Cooperative Pursuit of UAV Cluster Based on Graph Embedding Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Aiming at the cooperative behavior decision-making problem of UAV cluster cooperative pursuit of escaping UAVs, a cooperative pursuit target decision-making process model based on Dec-POMDP is established.Aiming at the uncertain and partially observable scenes caused by the limited perception and communication ability of UAV cluster system state, a dynamic graph embedding method is proposed.The cluster state embedded in the graph is represented as the network input under the AC framework. Through information fusion, the individuals in the cluster system can perceive the information of the surrounding UAVs, so as to produce the global situation.Based on the idea of centralized evaluation and distributed execution, a multi-agent strategy gradient method for double delay depth determination based on empirical playback region reconstruction is proposed.This method can be effectively combined with the graph embedding method to represent the state of cluster system. The above method is applied to the target pursuit of UAV cluster, and the learning process has good convergence.

articleTitle: A Comparative Study of Poisson Kriging's Matrix Solving Method and Surrogate Model Solving Method
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: This paper analyzes the calculation principles of Poisson Kriging, and then the Poisson Kriging is solved by matrix method and surrogate model method respectively. Based on the virtual radiation field data calculated by the superMC software, the radiation fields constructed by the two methods are compared. Then the difference is analyzed and explained through its covariance function model and correlation coefficient model. The main difference between the two methods is the smoothness of the radiation field and the relationship between the results and the sample. Through error calculation, it is shown that the surrogate model solution method is generally better than the matrix solution method.

articleTitle: Study on Ship Collision Risk Assessment and Anti-Collision Scheme of Cross-sea Bridges
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: To clarify the ship collision risk level and anti-collision ability of a cross-sea bridge, static and dynamic finite element (FE) models are established to analyze the anti-collision ability of the pier. The three-parameter model is used to analyze the short-term and long-term ship collision risks of the bridge. Based on the analysis results, the fortified standard and flexible anti-collision scheme of the bridge are proposed. Besides, the reliability of the connection between segments is also investigated. The results reveal that: (1) the transition pier and the first-span approach pier are at high risk and have insufficient anti-collision capability; (2) The connection is the most critical position under oblique collision. The peak dynamic tensile force of the connection under ship collision is 1.26 MN while the quasi-static tensile bearing capacity is 3.71 MN, and the tensile force is less than the tensile bearing capacity at any time.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction of Data Middle Platform for Smart Hydropower Station
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to improve the data service level of hydropower station, solve the problems of data island and data heterogeneity, and explore the value of massive data, the data middle platform is needed to construct which can improve the refined operation and management level of smart hydropower station effectively and improve the utilization rate of data. Firstly, this paper introduces the origin, definition, and development of the data middle platform, then introduces the four-layers architecture and key technologies of data middle platform for smart hydropower station in detail. Finally, some practical application scenarios are introduced and analyzed which has a certain reference value for the construction and application of data middle platform in smart hydropower station.

articleTitle: Research on Design and Optimization Technology of Mine-used Multi-output Intrinsically Safe Power Supply
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Underground conditions in coal mines are complex, the environment is harsh and the power supply voltage fluctuates greatly. Traditional linear power supplies are large and inefficient and no longer meet the power requirements of low-voltage equipment such as underground monitoring and surveillance and sensors. This paper first analyses the design requirements as well as the structure of an intrinsically safe power supply. The PWM control chip NCP1207 with soft-start and quasi-resonant functions is used to optimise the design of the multiple output circuits in the intrinsically safe power supply in order to further improve the quality and safety of the intrinsically safe power supply.

articleTitle: A Resilient Response Method of DDoS Attack Based on TCP Proxy
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The widespread distributed denial of dervice attack (DDoS) poses a major threat to network security. The emergence and vigorous development of NFV technology provides us with a new idea to deal with DDoS attack. In view of the weak defense ability of SYN flood attack response method in NFV, this paper proposes a resilient response method of DDoS attack based on TCP proxy. First, the distributed deployment method of traffic detection filtering device in NFV environment is determined. Second, a DDoS attack response mechanism based on TCP proxy is designed to realize the filtering of malicious traffic. Finally, the resource demand expansion of malicious traffic filtering in NFV is studied to realize the rapid expansion of resources and improve the defense ability to DDoS attacks. The method proposed in this paper can effectively block SYN flood attacks, realize the flexible deployment and resilient expansion of security services.

articleTitle: Distributed functional connectivity network method for identifying autism spectrum disorder
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Functional connectivity network (FCN) has been becoming an increasingly effective tool for exploring spontaneous brain activity and changes in brain function for the diagnosis of the autism spectrum disorder (ASD). The method of constructing FCN based on Matrix Variate Normal Distribution theory (MVND method) is one of the most effective methods recently proposed, which integrates the dynamic and high-order properties of the brain. However, in practice, the problem of too many parameters and insufficient samples makes the quality of feature extraction still have room for further improvement. To address this issue, we propose a distributed FCN method. Firstly, through k-means clustering we classify all rs-fMRI time series into several clusters. In each cluster, the MVND method is used to construct low- and high-order FCNs. For the loss of functional connectivity information caused by cluster division, we propose to use the paired Pearson Correlation of rs-fMRI mean time series of each cluster to make up. We verify the effectiveness of the distributed FCN method in the classification experiments of ASD subjects and normal controls (NCs). The experimental results show that the distributed FCN method achieves higher classification accuracy than MVND method, and the highest recognition rate is 78.26%.

articleTitle: Al Feasibility Study on Case Detection
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the current academic field, there are few researches on the connection between artificial intelligence (Al) and case detection, so it needs to find a new direction to make a breakthrough. Existing research mainly focuses on the integration of related technologies into public security applications, such as identity recognition technology in access control systems and image recognition technology for identity inspection in the railway station. However, in the deeper field of public security, such as criminal investigation, there is no trend to popularize the technology. This paper will focus on the principles of available Al technology, the problems in the detection of existing cases, how to integrate Al technology into the traditional model, and the possible hidden dangers in the future. The conclusion is that people can apply the existing artificial intelligence technologies such as voiceprint recognition and image recognition to criminal investigation

articleTitle: Intelligent Control of a Hypersonic Flight Vehicle Based on Active Disturbance Rejection Control
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: For the characteristics of strong coupling and strong nonlinearities of a hypersonic flight vehicle (HFV) and high requirements for the design of its controller, this paper is based on the nonlinear model of HFV and proposes the intelligent control method of HFV by combining active disturbance rejection control (ADRC) and reinforcement learning of deep deterministic policy gradient (DDPG). The intelligent control method proposed in this paper realizes the efficient attitude control of HFV in the cruise phase. The simulation results verify the effectiveness of this method for HFV control.

articleTitle: Optimization of process conditions for catalytic preparation of C4 olefins from ethanol based on Stochastic Forest algorithm
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: C4 olefin is an essential production raw material in the field of chemical industry and medicine. This paper primarily establishes a mathematical model based on the existing experimental data in order to investigate the optimal catalyst combination and temperature for Ethanol Catalysed preparation of C4 olefin. Firstly, we pretreated the variables and analysed the effects of catalyst loading mode with the addition of quartz sand on the selectivity of C4 olefins. Then the remaining four variables, as well as two dependent variables, are analysed by multiple linear regression and nonlinear regression. In the nonlinear regression method, we make use of the three different neural network algorithms: BP, RBF, and random forest. After considering the prediction results, the goodness of fit, and model stability, we believe that the effect of the random forest algorithm is better. On ethanol conversion and C4 olefin selectivity, the effects of different catalyst combinations and temperatures were acquired.

articleTitle: Design and Simulation of Permanent Magnet Synchronous Motor Controller for Twin Oar Electric Boat
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: A permanent magnet synchronous motor controller is designed for the Marine motor of an inland river electric boat. This paper gives the control block diagram of the double motor and designs the control circuit, isolation circuit, drive circuit, inverter circuit and detection circuit of the motor controller. The control circuit uses TI’s TMS320F28335 as the computing chip to control two motors to drive two propellers to power the ship. Because the application of electric ship is not as good as electric car, the design of its controller becomes particularly important. Control algorithm in this paper adopts the principle of vector control algorithm of space vector pulse width modulation, based on the design of permanent magnet synchronous motor hall sensor feedback system, using DSP chip, analyze the feedback data and output control signal control of permanent magnet synchronous motor, gives the circuit design and simulation verification.

articleTitle: A Knowledge-based Question-Answering Method for Military Critical Information Under Limited Corpus
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In the military field, question-answering (QA) to analysis, decision-making and other critical information is an important application of command and decision-making. Nowadays, in natural language processing, current knowledge-based intelligent QA systems have achieved significant improvement of efficiency and accuracy, while at the same time the quantity and scale of the corpus are required as well. However, in the field of military, the question and answer corpus of military critical information related to analysis and decision-making is commonly very limited. In this paper, we propose a knowledge-based military critical information QA method, aiming at realizing intelligent QA under the condition of the limited corpus. After constructing the corpus of military critical information questions, a template matching method based on the naive Bayes classifier is adopted to identify the categories of critical information questions. According to the question category, query statements are generated by filling question semantic information extracted in advance into query statement templates. Then, through querying the critical information knowledge graph, the QA for military critical information under the condition of the limited corpus can be achieved.

articleTitle: Ultrasound Thyroid Nodule Segmentation Based On Multi-branch and Color Space Volume
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Ultrasonic segmentation of thyroid nodules is an indispensable part of computer aided system and diagnosis of thyroid diseases. Due to the fact that ultrasound images have the characteristics of asymmetric irradiation, uneven appearance, low signal-to-noise ratio, low contrast and blurred boundary, thyroid nodule segmentation is a challenging task. In order to improve the precision of thyroid nodule segmentation, this paper presents an Ultrasound thyroid nodule segmentation algorithm based on multi-branch and color space volume. In this method, an image pyramid is constructed to compensate for the spatial information loss by convolutional and pooling operations. We use pretrained ResNet block as the Feature Encoder Module, a multi-branch convolutional fusion (MBCF) block is proposed to increase the receptive field and capture high-level spatial and semantic information. To further improve the segmentation performance, the color space volume transformation is used to highlight the contrast between the target area and the background in the data preprocessing part. Experimental results on an Ultrasound thyroid nodule segmentation dataset show that the proposed method performs well over the state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: An Outlier Fault Diagnosis Method Based on Principal Component of Entropy Weight
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In view of the limitations of previous data-driven fault diagnosis methods, this paper proposes a fault diagnosis method based on entropy weighted principal components, which mainly integrates the entropy weighting idea into the objective function of principal component analysis, and combines The similarity-based outlier detection algorithm can perform fault diagnosis more accurately. Simulation experiments using Tennessee Eastman process fault detection data set show that the proposed method can achieve better results.

articleTitle: IDMC-VSLAM: Improved dense map construction and visual SLAM in dynamic environments
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In this paper, an improved visual SLAM system is proposed. Firstly, we embed a lightweight convolutional neural networks for semantic segmentation into the visual SLAM to improve the efficiency of detecting moving objects in dynamic environments. Then, the detected moving objects are eliminated to improve the accuracy and robustness of visual SLAM. Subsequently, a dense point cloud map using unsupervised learning is proposed, for robot obstacle avoidance and path planning. Experimental results in the open TUM RGB-D dataset show that our method not only significantly improves the computational efficiency but also ensures the positioning accuracy.

articleTitle: Design of Control System for Heating Furnace based on Variable Domain Fuzzy Control
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In view of the characteristic of typical distributed parameters and complex modeling of the control system of rolling furnace, the variable domain fuzzy control algorithm is adopted. A fuzzy control strategy for rolling furnace under complex working conditions is proposed, the process state of rolling furnace is analyzed, the selection method of scaling factor under different errors is designed. The simulation results show that, the design of the control system improves the accuracy, and the overshoot is smaller, dynamic response performance is better.

articleTitle: Research on Architecture of Spacecraft Intelligent Control System
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Intelligent control system is the key subsystem to improve the autonomous operation ability and intelligence of spacecraft in orbit. The paper introduces the definition, basic characteristics and intelligent classification of spacecraft intelligent control system, puts forward an architecture of spacecraft intelligent control system based on time triggered Ethernet (TTE) technology, and gives the corresponding software architecture design,and points out the main contents and key technologies to be studied, It provides a technical reference for the development of spacecraft intelligent control system.

articleTitle: Structural strength analysis of crane setting of 4000t revolving floating crane
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Revolving floating crane plays an important role in terminal handling, marine engineering, salvage and channel dredging. With the heavy-duty development of revolving floating crane, ensuring the structural strength of the crane setting has a great impact on the safe operation of the revolving floating crane. In this paper, the structural strength of the crane setting is calculated by the FEM software MSC. Patran / MSC. NASTRAN. The calculated results are compared with the allowable stress value to prove that the structural strength meets the use requirements.

articleTitle: Participation of electrochemical energy storage in secondary frequency regulation of thermal power units
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In recent years, new energy power and other new energy power and other new energy power generations such as wind power and solar energy have led to a large number of thermal generators for a long time to hear heavy AGC regulatory tasks. And more and more pure coagulating thermal units are transformed into a heating unit, this increases grid Frequency adjustment difficulty. With the decline of lithium ion battery costs, the energy storage assisted heating thermomechanical unit involved in frequency modulation has become the best choice for improving the frequency modulation capability of thermal generators. The energy storage assisted heating thermomechanical unit involved in the frequency modulation, which not only improves the load adjustment energy of the thermal power unit, but also enables the unit to obtain more benefits in the auxiliary service market, but also helps the power grid in the new energy power generation, help China to achieve carbon-up peaks and Carbon neutralization. This paper analyzes the characteristics of energy storage and frequency modulation, which introduces the engineering and access to thermal power unit and control strategy. This paper analyzes the characteristics of energy storage participation in frequency modulation, and introduces method and control strategy of energy storage access to thermal power units.

articleTitle: Research on the Architecture of Shipborne UAV Target Indication Command and Control System based on DoDAF
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The latest Department of Defense Architecture Framework (DoDAF) emphasizes the consistency of data, which requires to ensure that the models are related to each other and the data contained can be reused repeatedly. Therefore, a model relevance judgment principle is proposed. Based on DM2 related concepts, this principle determines whether there is an association relationship between models required for modeling according to the number of common data element types included and whether views can iterate with each other, so as to optimize modeling steps and find out the sequence of model generation. The relevance principle is applied to the development of shipborne UAV target command and control system architecture, and a visual description is made for organizational relations, resource interaction and combat activities.

Author Keywords: shipborne UAV target indication command and control system

articleTitle: Research of Privacy Preservation of Data Aggregation in Wireless Sensor Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In wireless sensor networks, the private data collected by nodes are often aggregated to the base station for some important judgments and operations. How to ensure the privacy of the data aggregation process in wireless sensor networks has become a very important topic. This paper first combs various attacks on data privacy in wireless sensor networks, then combs and evaluates the common privacy preservation technologies, and finally prospects the future research work.

articleTitle: Research On 5G Encryption Algorithm Identification Scheme Based On Adaboost
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: 5G network is a new type of network method that is being popularized, and the study of identifying 5G encryption algorithms helps ciphertext analysis and improves 5G network security. In this paper, the feature extraction of ciphertext is carried out by means of information entropy and feature construction and feature screening in feature engineering. This uses the AdaBoost method in integrated learning to construct the encryption algorithm recognition scheme, analyze and recognize the data encrypted by AES and SM4 in four working modes, and obtain high recognition accuracy in some situations.

articleTitle: Research on Unstructured Data Access Strategy In Cloud Environment
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: For the problem of low storage efficiency of small files in HDFS (Hadoop Distributed File Systems, HDFS), a small file merging algorithm based on file type is proposed, and the model structure and implementation steps of the algorithm are studied. On the basis of the original architecture, ClientServer is added for data preprocessing. Finally, algorithms are designed for data "write and read" operations.

articleTitle: Semantic segmentation model for detection of people falling into the water based on DeepLabV3+
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: For the complex water surface environment, the detection of the person falling into the water needs to identify the person within the field of view, and at the same time, it is necessary to judge the environment in which the person is located, so that it can be comprehensively judged whether the person has fallen into the water. Therefore, in view of the blurring of the target boundary and target loss, this paper proposes a Mobile-DeepLabV3+ semantic segmentation model, which uses the MobilenetV3 network to replace the original improved Xception feature extraction network, and performs feature extraction on the input image; use The spatial pyramid structure of DeepLabV3+ performs multi-scale fusion of images to better show the details of image segmentation of people, ships, and water. The experimental results show that the training accuracy of the Mobile-DeepLabV3+ model on the self-made data set is 89.36%, and in the PSNR comparison experiment, the average improvement is about 7dB compared with other models, which has good accuracy.

articleTitle: Analysis of dynamic equivalent circuit model of single axle bogie
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Numerical analysis of mechanical system dynamics has the problems such as programming difficulty and slow calculation speed. The paper takes the single-axle bogie as the research object, establishes the linear dynamic equations which has two degrees of freedom of the transverse and yaw motions, and uses MATLAB to carry out the numerical simulation of the equations. On the base, an equivalent circuit model is built using operational amplifiers, resistors and capacitors, and the same results as numerical simulations are obtained through Multisim simulation. The equivalent circuit model has the advantages of simple design, high speed, and real-time adjustable parameters. In addition, oscilloscope and spectrum analyzer can be used for real-time online analysis of results. The research results show that using equivalent circuit models to analyze the dynamics of n-DOF mechanical systems has certain reference value.

articleTitle: Image Encryption System Based On Chaotic System And DNA Computing
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The misuse and arbitrary tampering of digital images by third parties pose a threat to the security and privacy of human subjects, requiring the development of good encryption techniques to meet the security needs of digital images. In this paper, we focus on the image encryption algorithm based on the combination of hyper chaotic system and DNA operation, which divides the digital image into three two-dimensional matrices by R, G and B channels, encrypts the image in blocks, and the chaotic sequence generated by the chaotic system determines the DNA coding, decoding and operation of each image block in the encryption process. The number of chaotic systems in the algorithm is increased and the encryption process is optimized to address the problems of low key space and inability to resist cropping attacks. The simulation results show that the improved encryption algorithm can resist the exhaustive key attack, the correlation of adjacent elements of the encrypted image is greatly reduced, and the encrypted image is resistant to cropping.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Electric Conductor Dynamic Response in Cold Region
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Strong winds and icing are the main natural disasters threatening the safe and stable operation of transmission lines in cold regions. Except for the study of transmission line galloping, the influence of wind load and icing load are usually considered separately in dynamic analysis of conductors in previous studies. In this paper, taking a two-span line section as an example, the wind deflection and motion trajectory of the conductor under the combined action of wind load during icing and ice shedding are studied. Through the comparative analysis of different spans, the effects ice shedding and wind load on conductor jump height, horizontal displacement and dynamic displacement between conductor and ground wire are obtained. The research results can provide reference for the design of transmission lines and provide technical support for the safe and stable operation of lines in alpine areas.

articleTitle: Comparison Analysis for Pruning Algorithms of Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Deep learning has been widely applied in many fields, such as big data analysis, natural language processing, and image processing, etc. However, the number of parameters in the deep learning model is often too large that the model would be difficult to apply portable devices. Therefore, the researches about pruning algorithms for optimizing the deep learning model has great significance. This paper conducts an in-depth analysis of the pruning algorithm in the model compression method. Besides, we classify and summarize the structure, scheduling, and scoring of the pruning algorithms. And then, the compression effects of some mainstream pruning algorithms on some deep neural networks including accuracy are compared and analyzed. Finally, the future development of the pruning algorithm is promising. Regardless of the different pruning approaches, the mainstream pruning algorithms can all effectively compress the size of the network model while maintaining basic accuracy. However, one pruning algorithm has a different performance when it is applied to different network models and datasets. The future pruning algorithm can be designed in terms of network sparsity structure, scheduling, and parameter ranking criteria. Moreover, the datasets and models are also required to be considered when the corresponding high-performance pruning strategies are used.

articleTitle: Predicting Differentiation Degree of Gastric Cancer Pathology Images Based on Mask Attention R-CNN
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Gastric cancer is one of the highest mortality cancers in the world. At present, pathological diagnosis is the gold standard for gastric cancer diagnosis. Deep Learning technique has been widely used in pathological diagnosis using medical images. The differentiation of gastric cancer cells is one of the important contents in the pathology report. The degree of tumor differentiation reflects the degree of cell maturity and the degree of malignancy of the tumor. It is of great significance to carry out early treatment and prognostic diagnosis. However, there are few related researches on the calculation of gastric cancer cell differentiation degree in medical imaging, since it is difficult to accurately segment the ROI (region of interest) of gastric cancer cells. In this paper, we propose an improved Mask R-CNN framework that called Mask Attention R-CNN to predict the differentiation degree of gastric cancer cells. The framework contains a mask attention block (MAB) that can calculate the Intersection over Union (IoU) of the predicted gastric cancer cell mask and mask feature map to enhance the mask quality. We also add a scale jittering strategy which can learn detailed information from images. As far as we know, this is the first study to apply the instance segmentation framework to the task of predicting differentiation degree of gastric cancer cells. The mask branch effectively improves the accuracy of the instance mask of gastric cancer cells. Both the location and classification accuracies of gastric cancer cells are improved by our model. This can provide pathologists with auxiliary diagnosis opinions, which has certain clinical application value.

articleTitle: A Hybrid evolutionary algorithm based on Artificial Bee Colony algorithm and Differential Evolution
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: In order to make up for the lack of local development capabilities of the classic artificial bee colony algorithm (ABC), an improved artificial bee colony search strategy is proposed: a new solution search equation is introduced, and a combined search strategy is formed with the original solution search equation in the classic artificial bee colony algorithm. To further improve the convergence speed and accuracy of the algorithm, an improved differential evolution strategy is proposed: a probability parameter is introduced to adjust the selection of the crossover probability of the differential evolution algorithm(DE); finally, in order to alleviate the harm of premature convergence caused by increasing the convergence speed, introduce An improvement mechanism; based on these three major improvements, a hybrid evolutionary algorithm based on ABC and DE is proposed. Then, based on a simulation experiment composed of benchmark test functions, the entire algorithm was verified. The results compared with the classic ABC and DE show that the improvement has obvious effects.

articleTitle: Toponym Based Community Search in Large Social Network
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: The geo-social community search problem, which aims to find a group of socially and geographically cohesive users in large social networks, has been well defined and investigated. However, instead of coordinates, there are more and more text locations be used to identify users, so the traditional coordinate based geo-social community search algorithm are no longer applicable, and it is necessary to design an algorithm based on the semantics of text locations to measure cohesive. In this paper, in order to overcome the shortcoming of traditional algorithm, we first propose an text location based geo-social community search algorithm by constructing a toponym graph, toponym graph is a kind of retrieval data structure which abstracts the real geographic topological relationship. In toponym graph, we quantify the semantic distance between two text locations and determine whether the two users are geographically close, and then find the socially and geographically cohesive community. After that, To solve the problem of high time complexity of the basic algorithm , we design an approximate algorithm to simplify the search process by setting the landmark nodes. And then we develop a series of pruning strategies to speed up the search. Finally, we verify the performance of our proposed algorithm and pruning strategies using some real world datasets.

articleTitle: A Fineset Cortex Atlas of Human Brain Based On Boundary Mapping Technique: An 7T fMRI Study
publicationTitle: 2021 2nd International Conference on Computer Engineering and Intelligent Control (ICCEIC)
abstract: Cortex atlases are critical to study the function and organization of human brain. Abrupt transitions in resting-stating functional connectivity (RSFC) are used to define the boundaries between different cortical areas. Ultrahigh field strength (7T) functional magnetic resonance imaging (fMRI) data have very high spatial revolution so that some areas which is difficult to be found in lower resolution fMRI data can be detected. Here, we utilized 7T resting-state fMRI data and boundary mapping method to parcellate the cortex of brain. The boundary maps obtained from the parcellation of two independent datasets were highly similar. The boundary map-derived parcels were significantly more homogenous than that of random null models and overlapped strongly with several known cytoarchitectonic areas. A parcellation consisting of 215 parcels for each hemisphere is provided, which appears to better represent the cortex organization of human brain than the previously published Gordon333 atlas [1].
